title: Card authorisations timing out with HTTP 504
summary: payments-api returned 504 for 7% of authorisations; ERR_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT and HikariPool connection not available errors.
root_cause: Deploy raised worker count without raising the RDS proxy connection limit; connection pool exhausted.
resolution: Rolled back payments-api to previous task definition revision; pool recovered in 6 minutes.

title: Acquirer latency spike causing gateway timeouts
summary: Upstream acquirer degraded; ERR_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT rate rose to 3%.
resolution: Enabled payments.acquirer.circuit_breaker flag and opened ticket with acquirer NOC.

title: Settlement batch stalled by deadlocks
summary: ORA-00060 deadlocks between settlement batch and intraday reconciliation.
root_cause: Two jobs updating ledger_entries in different key orders.
resolution: Paused recon-intraday job, let settlement drain, resumed.

title: 401 spike after IdP key rotation
summary: ERR_JWKS_FETCH errors after identity provider rotated signing keys.
root_cause: JWKS cache held stale keys for 24h.

title: Elevated 5xx during region failover drill
summary: Planned failover drill produced 2 minutes of 503s.
root_cause: DNS TTL longer than expected during drill.
resolution: No action; lowered TTL for next drill.

title: Journal posting latency high
summary: Posting latency p99 at 4s; investigation ongoing.
